#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build only the ABI2 packed bridge from pinned clean Git and a frozen lockfile.

No physical solver, old source suite, transport case or automatic canary runs.
An existing exact clean VigilODE checkout may be reused without network.
Every subprocess is bounded as a process group and keeps stdout/stderr.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback

LANE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HE29 = LANE.parent
REPO = HE29.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HE29.parent / "he28_strip_refinement_20261018/src"))
from execution import atomic_json, digest, manifest, run_process

VIGILODE_SOURCE = "a21d573980f66fe02891bd216153443b5352f921"
BASELINE_CODE = "1569f3718cd4b17a16936ad3d72bc7d5ed9b0f4f"
BRIDGE_PATHS = ["Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "src/lib.rs", "src/packed.rs", "include/he29_optimized_bridge.h"]
RUSTFLAGS = "-C\x1ftarget-cpu=x86-64"


def query(argv):
    return subprocess.run(argv, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30).stdout.strip()


def checked(argv, output, label, wall):
    receipt = run_process(argv, output / "commands" / label, wall)
    if receipt["returncode"] != 0 or receipt["timed_out"]:
        raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_BUILD_COMMAND_FAILED: " + label)
    return receipt


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="fresh directory outside the BASS_HE checkout")
    ap.add_argument("--source-revision", required=True, help="exact 40-character published BASS_HE commit")
    ap.add_argument("--vigilode-checkout", help="existing clean checkout exactly at the pinned SHA")
    ap.add_argument("--cargo", default="cargo")
    ap.add_argument("--rustc", default="rustc")
    ap.add_argument("--offline", action="store_true", help="require an already populated Cargo cache")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = Path(args.out).resolve()
    if out.is_relative_to(REPO):
        raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_BUILD_OUT_MUST_BE_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    try:
        if len(args.source_revision) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in args.source_revision):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_SOURCE_REVISION_REQUIRES_FULL_SHA")
        cargo = shutil.which(args.cargo)
        rustc = shutil.which(args.rustc)
        if not cargo or not rustc:
            raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_RUST_TOOLCHAIN_MISSING")
        cargo, rustc = str(Path(cargo).resolve(strict=True)), str(Path(rustc).resolve(strict=True))
        rust_version = query([rustc, "--version", "--verbose"])
        cargo_version = query([cargo, "--version", "--verbose"])
        compiler_hashes = {"rustc": digest(rustc), "cargo": digest(cargo)}
        if (not rust_version.splitlines()[0].startswith("rustc 1.94.1 ")
                or not cargo_version.splitlines()[0].startswith("cargo 1.94.1 ")
                or "host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" not in rust_version.splitlines()):
            raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_REQUIRES_RECORDED_RUST_CARGO_1_94_1_X86_64_LINUX")
        publication_head = query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"])
        if publication_head != args.source_revision:
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_PUBLISHED_SOURCE_SHA")
        publication_tree = query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"])
        # This builder consumes an explicitly published, clean checkout.
        if query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "status", "--porcelain"]):
            raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_REPOSITORY_DIRTY: use the published clean checkout")
        dependency = out / "vigilode"
        if args.vigilode_checkout:
            source = Path(args.vigilode_checkout).resolve(strict=True)
            if query(["git", "-C", str(source), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) != VIGILODE_SOURCE:
                raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_CHECKOUT_SHA")
            if query(["git", "-C", str(source), "status", "--porcelain"]):
                raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_CHECKOUT_DIRTY")
            dependency.symlink_to(source, target_is_directory=True)
        else:
            checked(["git", "clone", "--filter=blob:none", "--no-checkout",
                     "https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode.git", str(dependency)],
                    out, "clone", 300.)
            checked(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "sparse-checkout", "set", "--no-cone",
                     "/Cargo.toml", "/Cargo.lock", "/LICENSE", "/crates/", "/fixtures/"],
                    out, "sparse", 60.)
            checked(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "fetch", "origin", VIGILODE_SOURCE],
                    out, "fetch", 300.)
            checked(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "checkout", "--detach", VIGILODE_SOURCE],
                    out, "checkout", 300.)
        if query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) != VIGILODE_SOURCE:
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_FINAL_CHECKOUT_SHA")
        if query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "status", "--porcelain"]):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_FINAL_CHECKOUT_DIRTY")
        dependency_tree = query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"])
        dependency_lock = digest(dependency / "Cargo.lock")
        source_snapshot = manifest([LANE / "rust_bridge" / p for p in BRIDGE_PATHS], LANE)
        target_bridge = out / "rust_bridge"
        for relative in BRIDGE_PATHS:
            source = LANE / "rust_bridge" / relative
            target = target_bridge / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        staged_snapshot = {"rust_bridge/" + p: digest(target_bridge / p) for p in BRIDGE_PATHS}
        if staged_snapshot != source_snapshot:
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_STAGE_COPY_IDENTITY")
        # The existing upstream profile is not modified. The small bridge has
        # its own Cargo root and locked versions; no full-workspace test target.
        os.environ["RUSTC"] = rustc
        os.environ["CARGO_BUILD_JOBS"] = "2"
        os.environ["CARGO_INCREMENTAL"] = "0"
        os.environ["RAYON_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
        os.environ.pop("RUSTFLAGS", None)
        os.environ.pop("CARGO_BUILD_TARGET", None)
        for key in ("RUSTC_WRAPPER", "RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER"):
            os.environ[key] = ""
        # Explicitly override configured rustflags, including target features.
        os.environ["CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS"] = RUSTFLAGS
        argv = [cargo, "build", "--release", "--locked", "--lib", "--manifest-path",
                str(target_bridge / "Cargo.toml"), "--target-dir", str(out / "target")]
        if args.offline:
            argv.append("--offline")
        build = checked(argv, out, "build", 1800.)
        if ({"rust_bridge/" + p: digest(target_bridge / p) for p in BRIDGE_PATHS} != source_snapshot
                or manifest([LANE / "rust_bridge" / p for p in BRIDGE_PATHS], LANE) != source_snapshot):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_BUILD")
        if (query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) != VIGILODE_SOURCE
                or query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "status", "--porcelain"])
                or query(["git", "-C", str(dependency), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]) != dependency_tree
                or digest(dependency / "Cargo.lock") != dependency_lock):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_DEPENDENCY_CHANGED_DURING_BUILD")
        if (query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"]) != publication_head
                or query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]) != publication_tree
                or query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "status", "--porcelain"])
                or query([rustc, "--version", "--verbose"]) != rust_version
                or query([cargo, "--version", "--verbose"]) != cargo_version
                or {"rustc": digest(rustc), "cargo": digest(cargo)} != compiler_hashes):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_BUILD_OWNER_CHANGED")
        library = out / "target/release/libhe29_optimized_bridge.so"
        if not library.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_LINUX_LIBRARY_NOT_FOUND")
        data = {"schema": "he29.optimized.build.v1", "status": "COMPILED", "abi_version": 2,
                "baseline_code_revision": BASELINE_CODE, "vigilode_source": VIGILODE_SOURCE,
                "bass_publication_head": publication_head, "bass_publication_tree": publication_tree,
                "source_revision_argument": args.source_revision, "library_path": str(library),
                "library_sha256": digest(library), "bridge_sources": source_snapshot,
                "source_identity_before_after_match": True,
                "vigilode_tree": dependency_tree,
                "upstream_cargo_lock_sha256": dependency_lock,
                "rustc_sha256": compiler_hashes["rustc"], "cargo_sha256": compiler_hashes["cargo"],
                "compiler_binary_identity_before_after_match": True,
                "compiler_wrappers": "EXPLICIT_EMPTY_OVERRIDE", "cargo_encoded_rustflags": RUSTFLAGS,
                "rustc_verbose": rust_version, "cargo_version": cargo_version,
                "build_receipt": build, "build_jobs": 2, "fast_math_enabled": False,
                "physical_runs": 0, "source_suites_replayed": 0, "canary_runs": 0}
        atomic_json(out / "BUILD_IDENTITY.json", data)
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
    except BaseException as exc:
        atomic_json(out / "BUILD_FAILURE.json", {"status": "BUILD_FAILED", "error": repr(exc),
                    "traceback": traceback.format_exc(), "physical_runs": 0})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: watchdog
content:
"""Run only never-started HE29 cases in an existing original campaign.

The physical runner and admission are reused. A local watchdog correction
also kills residual group members after the leader exits during timeout.
Any occupied case/process path is preserved, including malformed/partial data.
Default is read-only planning; --execute enables absent-case dispatch only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib
import importlib.util
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

JOBS = ((2, 512), (4, 512), (8, 512), (4, 1024))
RUNNER_SHA = 'dabb4968e5247815b8d19c31d792187bad497b23bf2028ce2539613ed527ff7e'
EXECUTION_SHA = '876e43d76f0773a8d2c38e262902442c614a68334561f5e2a78024c659edb1c4'
CLASSIFIER_SHA = 'b1c7ece60f5c2e9c86ca50f006aeaca3cc04f7ff418467f3a96f72fb27f7f9f3'


def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def require_hash(path, expected):
    if not Path(path).is_file() or Path(path).is_symlink() or digest(path) != expected:
        raise ValueError('HE29_CONTROLLER_SOURCE_IDENTITY: ' + str(path))


def key(r, nodes):
    return f'm8_r{r}_table{nodes}'


def occupied(root, name):
    return any(p.exists() or p.is_symlink()
               for p in (Path(root) / name, Path(root) / (name + '_process')))


def run_process_group(argv, destination, timeout_s, *, execution):
    """Original process/evidence contract with descendant timeout cleanup.

    Waiting for the session leader does not reap or stop its descendants.
    Always signal the remaining group with KILL after a timeout, even when
    the leader already exited in response to TERM. No old process is targeted.
    """
    if not math.isfinite(timeout_s) or timeout_s <= 0:
        raise ValueError('HE29_TIMEOUT_DOMAIN')
    dst = Path(destination); dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    execution.atomic_json(dst / 'COMMAND.json', {'argv': list(map(str, argv)), 'timeout_s': timeout_s})
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for name in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS',
                 'NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS', 'BLIS_NUM_THREADS'):
        env[name] = '1'
    env.update(OMP_DYNAMIC='FALSE', OMP_PLACES='cores', OMP_PROC_BIND='close')
    start = time.monotonic(); timed_out = False; killed_group = False
    with (dst / 'stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout, (dst / 'stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
        p = subprocess.Popen(list(map(str, argv)), stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                             start_new_session=True, env=env)
        try:
            try:
                code = p.wait(timeout=timeout_s)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed_out = True
                try:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                try:
                    p.wait(timeout=3.)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    pass
                # The leader may already be reaped, while a native descendant
                # is still alive in the original process group.
                try:
                    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    killed_group = True
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                code = p.wait()
        except BaseException:
            try:
                os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            p.wait()
            raise
        stdout.flush(); stderr.flush(); os.fsync(stdout.fileno()); os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
    receipt = {'returncode': code, 'timed_out': timed_out, 'wall_s': time.monotonic() - start,
               'stdout_sha256': execution.digest(dst / 'stdout.log'),
               'stderr_sha256': execution.digest(dst / 'stderr.log'),
               'watchdog': 'he29.missing_controller.group_cleanup.v1',
               'timeout_residual_group_sigkill_sent': killed_group,
               'cleanup_scope': 'created POSIX process group; descendants escaping the group are outside this mechanism'}
    execution.atomic_json(dst / 'RECEIPT.json', receipt)
    return receipt


def original_budget(root, read_json, requested=None):
    design = read_json(Path(root) / 'DESIGN.json')
    if design.get('jobs') != [list(x) for x in JOBS]:
        raise ValueError('HE29_ORIGINAL_CAMPAIGN_JOBS_REQUIRED')
    if (design.get('concurrency') != 1 or design.get('stop_on_first_failure') is not True
            or design.get('integration_rtol') != 1e-10
            or design.get('integration_atol_scaled') != 1e-12):
        raise ValueError('HE29_ORIGINAL_CAMPAIGN_CONTRACT_CHANGED')
    limit = design.get('per_case_wall_s')
    if type(limit) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(limit) or not 0 < limit <= 3600:
        raise ValueError('HE29_ORIGINAL_CASE_BUDGET_INVALID')
    if requested is not None:
        if not math.isfinite(requested) or not 0 < requested <= limit:
            raise ValueError('HE29_CASE_BUDGET_CANNOT_INCREASE')
        limit = requested
    return float(limit), design


def build_plan(root, classification, expected_cohort):
    if classification.get('global_errors'):
        raise ValueError('HE29_EXISTING_TRUST_OR_BINARY_FAILURE')
    cases = classification.get('cases', [])
    if [x.get('key') for x in cases] != [key(*x) for x in JOBS]:
        raise ValueError('HE29_CLASSIFICATION_CASE_SET')
    rows = []
    cohort_conflicts = []
    for row in cases:
        name = row['key']
        present = occupied(root, name)
        if row.get('cohort_id') is not None and row.get('cohort_identity') != expected_cohort:
            cohort_conflicts.append(name)
        if present:
            action = 'REUSE_ADMITTED' if row.get('admitted') else 'PRESERVE_OCCUPIED_HOLD'
        elif row.get('status') == 'ABSENT' and not row.get('files'):
            action = 'RUN_NEVER_STARTED'
        else:
            action = 'CLASSIFICATION_FILESYSTEM_CONFLICT_HOLD'
        rows.append({'case': name, 'action': action, 'observed_status': row.get('status'),
                     'admitted': bool(row.get('admitted')), 'occupied': present})
    return {'cases': rows, 'cohort_conflicts': cohort_conflicts,
            'execution_allowed': not cohort_conflicts and not any(
                x['action'] == 'CLASSIFICATION_FILESYSTEM_CONFLICT_HOLD' for x in rows),
            'never_started': [x['case'] for x in rows if x['action'] == 'RUN_NEVER_STARTED'],
            'preserved': [x['case'] for x in rows if x['occupied']],
            'budget_semantics': 'Original per-case budget only for absent case AND process paths; no occupied case is retried. No aggregate campaign deadline is reset.'}


def active_original_runners(runner, root, proc_root=Path('/proc')):
    """Observe visible Linux processes; do not send signals to old processes."""
    if not proc_root.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError('HE29_PROCESS_OBSERVATION_REQUIRES_LINUX_PROC')
    runner, root = str(Path(runner).resolve()), Path(root).resolve()
    matches, denied = [], []
    for p in proc_root.iterdir():
        if not p.name.isdigit() or int(p.name) == os.getpid():
            continue
        try:
            args = (p / 'cmdline').read_bytes().decode(errors='replace').split('\0')
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        except PermissionError:
            denied.append(int(p.name)); continue
        if (not any(Path(x).name == 'reference_runner.py' for x in args if x)
                or not any(x in args for x in ('case', 'campaign')) or '--out' not in args):
            continue
        try:
            output = Path(args[args.index('--out') + 1])
            if not output.is_absolute():
                output = (p / 'cwd').resolve(strict=True) / output
            output = output.resolve()
        except (IndexError, FileNotFoundError):
            continue
        if output == root or root in output.parents:
            matches.append({'pid': int(p.name), 'output': str(output)})
    if denied:
        raise RuntimeError('HE29_PROCESS_VISIBILITY_INCOMPLETE: ' + str(denied))
    return matches


@contextlib.contextmanager
def campaign_lock(root):
    path = Path(root) / '.he29_missing_controller.lock'
    if path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('HE29_CONTROLLER_LOCK_SYMLINK')
    with path.open('a') as f:
        fcntl.flock(f, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(f, fcntl.LOCK_UN)


def dispatch_absent(root, plan, *, run_process, command_for, case_wall_s, classify, write_json, out):
    """Small orchestration seam: production supplies pinned original functions."""
    if not plan['execution_allowed']:
        raise ValueError('HE29_COHORT_OR_SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT')
    records = []
    for r, nodes in JOBS:
        name = key(r, nodes)
        if name not in plan['never_started']:
            continue
        # Recheck immediately before the original watchdog reserves its process dir.
        if occupied(root, name):
            records.append({'case': name, 'status': 'BECAME_OCCUPIED_HOLD'})
            break
        info = run_process(command_for(r, nodes), Path(root) / (name + '_process'), case_wall_s)
        records.append({'case': name, 'process': info})
        snapshot = classify()
        write_json(Path(out) / (name + '_CLASSIFICATION.json'), snapshot)
        result = next(x for x in snapshot['cases'] if x['key'] == name)
        if info['returncode'] != 0 or info['timed_out'] or not result.get('admitted'):
            break
    return records


def load_production(baseline, analysis):
    baseline, analysis = Path(baseline).resolve(), Path(analysis).resolve()
    execution = baseline.parent / 'he28_strip_refinement_20261018/src/execution.py'
    runner = baseline / 'src/reference_runner.py'
    classifier = analysis / 'continuation_20261020T0557Z/src/partial_returns.py'
    require_hash(execution, EXECUTION_SHA); require_hash(runner, RUNNER_SHA)
    require_hash(classifier, CLASSIFIER_SHA)
    sys.path[:0] = [str(baseline / 'src'), str(classifier.parent)]
    pr = importlib.import_module('partial_returns')
    for relative, sha in pr.SCIENCE_SOURCES.items():
        require_hash(baseline / relative, sha)
    require_hash(analysis / 'src/reference_contract.py', pr.SCIENCE_SOURCES['src/reference_contract.py'])
    # partial_returns prepends its own source root; runner must use baseline DATA.
    sys.path.insert(0, str(baseline / 'src'))
    rr = importlib.import_module('reference_runner')
    ex = importlib.import_module('execution')
    if Path(ex.__file__).resolve() != execution or Path(rr.__file__).resolve() != runner:
        raise ValueError('HE29_IMPORTED_WATCHDOG_PATH')
    return rr, pr, ex, runner


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--baseline-root', required=True, help='Original1569 HE29 source with both published overlays and verified DATA')
    ap.add_argument('--analysis-root', required=True, help='HE29 source at09929b0 or byte-identical successor containing classifier')
    ap.add_argument('--root', required=True, help='Existing original references/ directory; its DESIGN is immutable')
    ap.add_argument('--binary', required=True); ap.add_argument('--receipt', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--out', required=True, help='New controller evidence directory')
    ap.add_argument('--case-wall-s', type=float)
    ap.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root, out = Path(args.root).resolve(), Path(args.out).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        ap.error('existing original references root required')
    if out == root or root in out.parents:
        ap.error('controller output must be outside original references root')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    started = time.monotonic()
    ex = None
    try:
        rr, pr, ex, runner = load_production(args.baseline_root, args.analysis_root)
        limit, design = original_budget(root, pr.read_json, args.case_wall_s)
        state = rr.check_sources(args.binary, args.receipt)
        expected = {k: state[k] for k in pr.COHORT_FIELDS}
        expected['runtime'] = {k: state['runtime'][k] for k in ('python', 'numpy', 'scipy')}
        classify = lambda: pr.classify_campaign(root, binary=args.binary, data_root=args.baseline_root)
        before = classify()
        plan = build_plan(root, before, expected)
        processes = active_original_runners(runner, root)
        ex.atomic_json(out / 'BEFORE.json', before)
        ex.atomic_json(out / 'PLAN.json', {**plan, 'case_wall_s': limit,
            'original_design_sha256': digest(root / 'DESIGN.json'), 'visible_active_original_runners': processes,
            'baseline_root': str(Path(args.baseline_root).resolve()), 'analysis_root': str(Path(args.analysis_root).resolve()),
            'binary_sha256': state['binary_sha256'], 'source_files': state['source_files'],
            'mode': 'execute' if args.execute else 'plan', 'native_calls_in_planning': 0})
        if not args.execute:
            return 0 if plan['execution_allowed'] and not processes else 1
        if processes:
            raise RuntimeError('HE29_EXISTING_ORIGINAL_PROCESS_ACTIVE')
        with campaign_lock(root):
            # A second controller may have finished between initial intake and lock.
            plan = build_plan(root, classify(), expected)
            if active_original_runners(runner, root):
                raise RuntimeError('HE29_EXISTING_ORIGINAL_PROCESS_ACTIVE')
            def command_for(r, nodes):
                return [sys.executable, str(runner), 'case', '--out', str(root / key(r, nodes)),
                        '--binary', str(Path(args.binary).resolve()), '--receipt', str(Path(args.receipt).resolve()),
                        '--strips', str(r), '--table-nodes', str(nodes)]
            records = dispatch_absent(root, plan,
                                     run_process=lambda argv, dst, timeout: run_process_group(argv, dst, timeout, execution=ex),
                                     command_for=command_for,
                                     case_wall_s=limit, classify=classify, write_json=ex.atomic_json, out=out)
        after = classify()
        ex.atomic_json(out / 'AFTER.json', after)
        ex.atomic_json(out / 'SUMMARY.json', {'schema': 'he29.missing_controller.v1', 'records': records,
            'started_cases': len([x for x in records if 'process' in x]), 'complete': after['complete'],
            'admitted_pairs': after['admitted_pairs'], 'case_wall_s': limit,
            'wall_s': time.monotonic() - started, 'old_cases_replayed': 0,
            'old_design_and_summary_rewritten': False, 'original_campaign': str(root),
            'physical_claim': 'Same finite HE29 reference admission only',
            'watchdog_grace': 'SIGTERM wait up to3s then residual-group SIGKILL even if leader exited; case_wall_s is wait budget, not a hard total-wall certificate'})
        return 0 if after['complete'] else 1
    except BaseException as exc:
        failure = {'error': repr(exc), 'wall_s': time.monotonic() - started,
            'old_cases_replayed': 0, 'remaining_action': 'Inspect retained records; occupied cases are not automatically retried'}
        if ex is not None:
            ex.atomic_json(out / 'FAILURE.json', failure)
        else:
            # Source import failures still have a create-only record; no imported
            # code from an unverified source is used to create this record.
            with (out / 'FAILURE.json').open('x') as f:
                json.dump(failure, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
                f.write('\n'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
        raise


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""One opt-in ABI2 HE29 r4/table512 canary after four admitted references.

Reuse the original baseline, microphysics, table and admission contracts.  The
controller bounds the entire POSIX process group.  It never launches baseline
solvers, old transport cases, old tests, parallel canaries or a wider grid.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback

LANE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HE29 = LANE.parent
REPO = HE29.parents[1]
OLD_LANE = HE29 / "vigilode_20261019"
sys.path.insert(0, str(HE29 / "src"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(OLD_LANE / "src"))
from reference_runner import (check_sources, NativeOwner, GridSpec, THREADS,
    check_result, admit_pair, atomic_json, digest, manifest, run_process)
from reference_contract import JOBS
from run_vigilode import baseline_contract as original_baseline_contract
from optimized_model import OptimizedRefinedSourceModel
from packed_reference import PackedBridge, solve_packed, verify_build

WORKER_FLAG = "HE29_PACKED_PROCESS_GROUP_WORKER"
CASE = dict(m=8, r=4, angles=4, q=0., table_nodes=512)
REUSED_ADAPTERS = ("run_vigilode.py", "vigilode_callbacks.py", "vigilode_reference.py")


def query(argv, *, strip=True):
    text = subprocess.run(argv, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
                          timeout=30).stdout
    return text.strip() if strip else text


def baseline_contract(root, current):
    """Original four-pair admission, with runtime equality for every pair."""
    root = Path(root)
    result, reused = original_baseline_contract(root, current)
    receipts = {}
    for r, nodes in JOBS:
        case = root / f"m8_r{r}_table{nodes}"
        identity = json.loads((case / "IDENTITY.json").read_text())
        for key in ("python", "numpy", "scipy"):
            if identity.get("runtime", {}).get(key) != current["runtime"][key]:
                raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_BASELINE_RUNTIME: " + case.name + ": " + key)
        receipts[case.name] = {name: digest(case / name)
            for name in ("IDENTITY.json", "RESULT.json", "TABLE.json")}
    return result, {**reused, "all_pair_receipts": receipts,
                    "runtime_matched_pairs": 4,
                    "source_binary_input_thread_matched_pairs": 4}


def publication_contract(revision, build, current):
    if (len(revision) != 40
            or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in revision)):
        raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_SOURCE_REVISION_REQUIRES_FULL_SHA")
    if build.get("bass_publication_head") != revision:
        raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_BUILD_PUBLICATION_MISMATCH")
    head = query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    if head != revision:
        raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_RUN_PUBLICATION_MISMATCH")
    status = query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "status", "--porcelain=v1",
                    "--untracked-files=all", "-z"], strip=False)
    if status and not status.endswith("\0"):
        raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_RUN_GIT_STATUS_FORMAT")
    allowed = {str((HE29 / path).relative_to(REPO)): sha
               for path, sha in current["input_sources"].items()}
    restored = {}
    for record in status.split("\0")[:-1]:
        if not record.startswith("?? "):
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_RUN_TRACKED_SOURCE_DIRTY")
        path = record[3:]
        if path not in allowed or digest(REPO / path) != allowed[path]:
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_RUN_UNVERIFIED_UNTRACKED_FILE: " + path)
        restored[path] = allowed[path]
    return {"source_revision_argument": revision, "head": head,
            "tree": query(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"]),
            "tracked_clean": True, "verified_untracked_input_data": restored,
            "clean_except_verified_input_data": True}


def preflight(args):
    current = check_sources(args.binary, args.owner_receipt)
    prior, reused = baseline_contract(args.baseline_campaign, current)
    build = verify_build(args.library, args.bridge_receipt)
    publication = publication_contract(args.source_revision, build, current)
    return current, prior, reused, build, publication


def run_case(args):
    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        current, prior, reused, build, publication = preflight(args)
        if any(os.environ.get(k) != v for k, v in THREADS.items()):
            raise ValueError("HE29_SINGLE_THREAD_ENV_REQUIRED")
        if os.environ.get("RAYON_NUM_THREADS") != "1":
            raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_SINGLE_RAYON_THREAD_REQUIRED")
        identity = {**current, **CASE, "bridge": build, "reused": reused,
            "publication": publication,
            "new_adapter_sources": manifest(sorted((LANE / "src").glob("*.py")), LANE),
            "reused_adapter_sources": manifest(
                [OLD_LANE / "src" / name for name in REUSED_ADAPTERS], OLD_LANE.parent),
            "rayon_num_threads": "1", "packed_threads": 1,
            "source_table_budget": {"wall_s": 600., "estimated_allocation_bytes": 2*1024**3,
                                    "whole_process_rss_bound": False}}
        atomic_json(out / "IDENTITY.json", identity)
        bridge = PackedBridge(args.library, args.bridge_receipt)
        with NativeOwner(args.binary, evidence_path=out / "native.jsonl.gz",
                         expected_binary_sha256=current["binary_sha256"]) as owner:
            model = OptimizedRefinedSourceModel(owner,
                GridSpec(m=8, angles=4, q=0., strips=4), tabulate=True,
                source_table_nodes=512, max_table_bytes=2*1024**3,
                max_table_wall_s=600.)
            table = model.source_table_sha256
            atomic_json(out / "TABLE.json", {"source_table_sha256": table,
                                            "diagnostics": model.source_table_diagnostics})
            if table != prior["table_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("HE29_OPT_REBUILT_TABLE_MISMATCH")
            with (out / "SEGMENT_ENDPOINTS.jsonl").open("x") as trace:
                def checkpoint(row):
                    text = json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
                    if trace.tell() + len(text.encode()) > 128*1024**2:
                        raise RuntimeError("HE29_OPT_ENDPOINT_TRACE_BUDGET")
                    trace.write(text)
                    trace.flush()
                    os.fsync(trace.fileno())
                result = solve_packed(model, bridge, checkpoint)
            # Keep actual output before the unchanged physical/method gates.
            atomic_json(out / "PACKED_RAW.json", {"result": result,
                        "native_calls": owner.calls, "wall_s": time.monotonic() - start})
            check_result(result)
            comparisons = {method: admit_pair(result, prior["results"][method])
                           for method in ("Radau", "DOP853")}
            calls = owner.calls
        atomic_json(out / "RESULT.json", {
            "schema": "he29.optimized.canary.v1", "status": "CANARY_COMPLETED_SCOPED",
            "case": CASE, "table_sha256": table, "result": result,
            "comparison_to_saved_baseline": comparisons,
            "native_calls": calls, "wall_s": time.monotonic() - start,
            "baseline_pairs_reused": 4, "new_baseline_pairs": 0,
            "transport_replays": 0, "source_only_suites_replayed": 0,
            "packed_threads": 1, "continuous_spectrum": "HOLD", "full_eor": "HOLD",
            "global_gas_temperature_bound": "HOLD",
            "upstream_grackle_whole_runtime_equivalence": "HOLD",
            "observational_bianchi_cmb": "HOLD"})
    except BaseException as exc:
        atomic_json(out / "FAILURE.json", {"status": "HOLD_FIRST_FAILURE", "error": repr(exc),
            "traceback": traceback.format_exc(), "wall_s": time.monotonic() - start,
            "baseline_pairs_created": 0, "transport_replays": 0,
            "retained_raw_files": [name for name in
                ("TABLE.json", "SEGMENT_ENDPOINTS.jsonl", "PACKED_RAW.json", "native.jsonl.gz")
                if (out / name).exists()]})
        raise


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("mode", choices=("preflight", "canary", "_worker"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--baseline-campaign", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--binary", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--owner-receipt", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--library", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--bridge-receipt", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--source-revision", required=True,
                    help="exact published code_commit from this lane's DELIVERY.json")
    ap.add_argument("--wall-s", type=float, default=900.)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if not math.isfinite(args.wall_s) or not 0 < args.wall_s <= 3600:
        ap.error("wall budget must be finite, positive and <=3600 seconds")
    if args.mode == "_worker":
        if os.environ.get(WORKER_FLAG) != "1":
            ap.error("use canary mode for enforced process-group timeout")
        run_case(args)
        return
    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    try:
        current, prior, reused, build, publication = preflight(args)
        atomic_json(out / "PREFLIGHT.json", {"status": "PASS", "reused": reused,
            "bridge": build, "publication": publication, "native_solver_calls": 0})
        if args.mode == "preflight":
            return
        argv = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_worker",
                "--out", str(out / "case"), "--source-revision", args.source_revision]
        for option, value in (("baseline-campaign", args.baseline_campaign), ("binary", args.binary),
                ("owner-receipt", args.owner_receipt), ("library", args.library),
                ("bridge-receipt", args.bridge_receipt)):
            argv += ["--" + option, str(Path(value).resolve())]
        os.environ["RAYON_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
        os.environ[WORKER_FLAG] = "1"
        receipt = run_process(argv, out / "process", args.wall_s)
        atomic_json(out / "SUMMARY.json", {
            "new_canary_cases": int(receipt["returncode"] == 0 and not receipt["timed_out"]),
            "requested_canary_cases": 1, "new_baseline_pairs": 0,
            "transport_replays": 0, "packed_threads": 1, **receipt})
        if receipt["returncode"] != 0 or receipt["timed_out"]:
            raise SystemExit(1)
    except BaseException as exc:
        if not (out / "FAILURE.json").exists():
            atomic_json(out / "FAILURE.json", {"status": "HOLD_FIRST_FAILURE", "error": repr(exc),
                "traceback": traceback.format_exc(), "native_submission_claimed": False})
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
